title: Play on People's Need to Believe to Create a Cultlike Following
hook: The wellness signal is quiet enough to miss and costly enough to matter.
counterintuition: People rarely follow a cold argument for long. They move more readily when a belief gives their frustration, hope, or longing a shared shape.
tryThisNow: Take the next request, update, or confrontation and mark where belief could misfire. Adjust the first move, not the final speech.
keyTakeaway: Give people a belief structure they want to enter before you ask for loyalty.

breakdown.fastRead:
Ben lays out the swatch in the restaurant pass. The play choice looks small, yet it can shift belief.

breakdown.fullRead: Eve sees the limit clearly in neighborhood repair cafe giving members a shared repair pledge. The move helps only when it stays narrower than running a fake cult or making wild promises. If it becomes a pose, it loses the practical force that made it useful.
